specialAttack.name: Rage
specialAttack.description: shifting rage: instead of rage's bonuses and penalties, she becomes a Medium {choice:animal} as beast shape I (her class level as caster level); rage's other limits still apply

Shifting Rage.descriptionOnly: no path: the animal form is a condition of its own (as beast shape I)

Hybrid Rage.descriptionOnly: no path: the hybrid form is a condition of its own

Greater Shifting Rage.descriptionOnly: no path: the larger forms are conditions of their own (as beast shape II)

Mighty Shifting Rage.descriptionOnly: no path: the larger forms are conditions of their own (as beast shape III)
